text:
rachel: Heads-up 1 Halberd dropped two LoRA adapters and a tiny tokenizer remap into intake. Need a short compatibility smoke (float32/int8/int4) and a minimal repro if we see regressions.

omar: Got it. Base model? adapter order? any token additions?

li: Base = gptx-7b-cust. Apply adapters in order: nl_dialog.lora then faq_instruct.lora. Tokenizer patch adds a single special token <HAL_TOK> and remaps digits 6-8 to adjacent ids.

kevin: Note: remapping contiguous digit range once caused multi-token splits in europe locales. Watch tokenization roundtrip and top-1 token deltas.

rachel: Smoke checklist: 1) tokenization roundtrip on 1k examples, 2) perplexity float32 vs int8 vs int4, 3) per-prompt top-1 prob diffs (flag >0.15), 4) embedding cos-sim vs 5 refs (mean/std), 5) regen A/B on 20 prompts (dialog/instruct/numeric). Include KV warmstart prefix.

omar: I'll assemble 24 prompts and run float32 then quantized modes. Collect token_probs and embeddings. Command I'll use locally:

```
python ci/eval_quick.py \
  --model gptx-7b-cust \
  --adapters nl_dialog.lora,faq_instruct.lora \
  --tokenizer-patch halberd_tok.json \
  --quants float32,int8,int4 \
  --prompts halberd_quick_prompts.json \
  --warm-prefix "[KS]" \
  --collect token_probs,embeddings \
  --out s3://redwood-ci/halberd/3612345678/results.zip
```

ci-bot: CI job queued: run/halberd-smoke-3612345678

ci-bot: CI started: setup -> running

ci-bot: CI finished: SUCCESS. Artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/halberd/3612345678/results.zip

omar: Quick findings: prompt_08 (numeric edge) top-1 shift float32->int4 = 0.31; prompt_15 (dialog) shift = 0.16. Embedding cos-sim on numeric subset drops from 0.95 -> 0.86 in int4. Most other prompts <0.07 shifts.

li: Token roundtrip test shows digits 7 and 8 now split into two tokens when adjacent to punctuation. That matches the observed KL spikes.

kevin: Triage suggestion: short-term recommend int8 fallback for production. Longer term ask Halberd to preserve single-token digits for 6-8 or provide a pre-tokenize remap.

rachel: Actions: omar to upload minimal repro (prompts 08 & 15) + token traces; li to add targeted tokenizer unit tests; kevin to draft customer note recommending int8 and describing repro.

omar: Uploaded repro bundle and token traces: s3://redwood-ci/halberd/3612345678/repro_08_15.tar.gz

ci-bot: Artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-ci/halberd/3612345678/repro_08_15.tar.gz

li: I'll open a small PR with a pre-tokenize remap option and a unit that fails on multi-token digits. ETA 2 business days.

kevin: I'll draft the account note and include the artifacts + suggested mitigations. Will cc AE after li confirms PR ETA.

rachel: Thanks team 1 good quick loop. We can close this thread once PR is in and AE is looped in.
